style: Premium Warcraft collectible illustration, painterly realism with crisp focal edges and broad calm shadow shapes; restrained antique-gold material accents, not gold outlines. Vertical 2:3 image. Entire standing figure and equipment inside the canvas, head near 27% height, feet near 80% height. Character occupies about 55% image height, with clear separation from background. Top 10% is calm dark atmosphere for a program-rendered ribbon, bottom 17% is quiet ground for a program-rendered nameplate. Keep face, hands and weapon sharp. Background has three readable depth planes and only two or three characteristic objects, softened by atmosphere. One dominant luminous shape behind the upper body; any weapon glow remains subordinate. Rich but controlled color, no blown-out white areas. Full-bleed artwork ONLY: no card border, typography, letters, numbers, signature, logo, watermark or interface. No extra people, no dense particles, no gold tracery over the face or background. Highest available native detail, ideally 1536x2304 or larger; do not sacrifice framing for detail.
heightPrompt: Convert the supplied illustration into a perfectly registered grayscale sculptural HEIGHT MAP for the same card, preserving the exact canvas aspect ratio, camera, silhouette, body proportions, face position, fingers, weapon shape, scene layout and every object location. This is a technical displacement map, not a grayscale photograph: depth determines value, illumination and material color do not. Dark background sky 15-30, distant buildings 40-65, middle-ground scenery 70-100, ground smoothly receding, main character body 155-205, nose/knuckles/front armor up to 225, weapon at the same depth as the hands. The entire main figure must be clearly raised even where its original clothing was dark. Smooth modeled anatomical volumes and broad rounded cloth folds, no painted highlights, no cast shadows, no fine scratches, no rim light. The moon or luminous opening is a shallow low dome around 45-65, behind the character, never brighter than the body. Transparent magic, mist and sparks stay near their background depth and are not solid protrusions. Smooth transitions, deep readable relief, strictly neutral grayscale, no color, no text, no border. Output exactly the same composition, not a newly imagined painting.

She holds one long staff upright beside her with a softly glowing blue crystal; the other hand relaxed in a restrained spell gesture, all fingers anatomically correct. Standing on a wet stone quay in Boralus at night. Behind her a single large pale moon, centered around x=50%, y=23%, provides the main light shape. Midground: one tall sailing ship with readable masts and a stone harbor arch, distant Kul Tiran roofs in mist. Foreground: one coiled mooring rope and a bollard at the extreme lower side, clear ground under both feet. Deep marine blue, desaturated teal, ivory, aged brass. Face and coat read clearly at thumbnail size. No second halo, no lighthouse beam, no glowing ship, no crowded boats. Keep boots above the bottom nameplate area.
